## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits, e.g. `feat(missions): add the static route mission`
- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes locally (lint, types, tests, build)
- [ ] New behavior has tests; a mission change has golden runs recorded on the real image
- [ ] Comments say _why_, not _what_; docstrings only where the name and type aren't enough
- [ ] Docs updated if a design decision changed
- [ ] A change players or contributors notice has a line under `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Mission text checked against the real Machine (output copied from a real run, not typed)
